  "Title": "Regional Harmonisation of TVET Qualifications in East Africa: Progress, Challenges, and Way Forward",

  "STUDY_CHARACTERISTICS": {

    ]
  },
  "KEY_FINDINGS": {
    "Main_Findings": [
      "Progress has been made in developing regional TVET standards and qualifications frameworks.",
      "Challenges remain in implementation due to varying national contexts and capacities.",
      "Political will and stakeholder engagement are crucial for successful harmonization.",
      "Mutual recognition of qualifications is still limited in practice."

      "Varying national TVET systems and priorities",
      "Limited resources and capacity",
      "Lack of political will",
      "Resistance from some stakeholders",
      "Inadequate communication and coordination"

      "Strong political commitment from EAC member states",
      "Effective stakeholder engagement",
      "Adequate resources and capacity building",
      "Clear and consistent communication",
      "Harmonized quality assurance mechanisms"
